## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Niè-pán jīng shū* in 33 fascicles is the great Suí-period Tiāntái commentary on *Dà bān niè pán jīng* 大般涅槃經 ([KR6g0001](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0001)) by [灌頂](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%81%8C%E9%A0%82) Guàndǐng. Together with *Dà bān niè pán jīng xuán yì* 大般涅槃經玄義 ([KR6g0005](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0005), T1765), it constitutes the canonical Tiāntái-school doctrinal apparatus on the *Niè-pán jīng*. The 33-fascicle scope makes it one of the most substantial single Tiāntái-school commentaries.
